notes.title: Update/patch has been cancelled!
notes.notes:
Hello people!

We are sad to say that after many hours of work and preparation for another patch we have come to a complete halt.

Recently we lost another member of our team and we wish the family our full condolences. Since we started this project we have lost 4 team members now and each time it has been more and more difficult to keep this project going. 

We apologise to anyone who is disappointed and it was never our intention to do this to our fans but under the circumstances it has become impossible to continue this project. We could not even resort to our old backup files because they were damaged 12 months ago from an electrical fault that also destroyed years and years of irreplaceable work. So even if we wanted to continue this ourselves independently we have lost too much data and experienced staff. Sadly some things must come to an end.

Therefore, due to our current overhead running costs and lack of staff who were part of the original project, we have to sadly say farewell to our project "DASM Spell Quest". 

A huge thank you to all the people who were involved in this project. The game will be "as is" for now and we will try our best to add some files in the workshop that will open all the levels and help anyone who wishes to unlock certain achievements. 

Leaving on a positive we do have other projects being created currently that use the UE4 engine and will be released later this year.

Thank you to all the fans who supported us over the years!

notes.title: IBT Island and IBT Island Origional
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28784825/b68ed1f72efed6cf655290b421267a7cd3738015.jpg[/img]
[h3]WARNING!... AUSSIE SLANG BELOW! (A dictionary may be required.)[/h3]
[h1]An Aussie game designed by legit Ferrals![/h1]

From the creators of the [i][b]World of DASM Spell Quest series[/b][/i] and still [u][b]"Under Construction"[/b][/u] we proudly introduce to you "IBT Island". It is currently being tested in a small but quaint community, IBT Island is a survival based game from Australia. With real Aussie terrain and native foods including a combination of introduced species of animals and true blue Aussie animals. 

[u][b]So where are we going with this blinking story?[/b][/u]

You wake up on an abandoned Island somewhere off of the coast of Australia. You have no idea how you got there or why you are there. One thing you do know is that you are in a lot of bloomin trouble cobber. You can seek help to bugger off of the island by building various types of signals or even hang around if you wish. While on the island you can find answers to why you are there or just be ignorant and live life like a Bogan. The choices are yours to make mate.

[list]
[*] Gather resources for your esky so you can eat and drink or you will be thirstier than a dingo and hungrier than a starving crow but its always best to remain Chockers.
[*] Be like a Tradie and build a Humpy or Wurley to live in or one of those big rich places.
[*] Watch out for nasty little critters.
[*] Visit the dunny or long drop from time to time. (I don't have to explain this.....do I?)
[*] Wear your Togs and be a Grommet and live on a beach but don't be a Shark biscuit.
[*] Wear Speedos and Stubbies during the day and chuck on the Flannie and Dacks during the night.
[*] Learn to be Fair Dinkum and don't whinge or sook.
[*] Avoid being a Drongo or you might get crook, deadset.
[*] Check out the native Olah Woop Woop Straya outback. Chew on some Salt Bush, make  a Damper or wack on a Quandong pie.
[*] There is a bonus game chucked in too and that's all I'm sayin so be really stoked about it.
[/list]

[u][b]I'm swishing the flies away till the cows come home but can't see where IBT Island is?[/b][/u]

The Mozzies too loud mate? Like we said IBT Island is still being whacked together and is at its joey stage. Just be patient and it will all be sweet as but we are known to chuck a sickie and have a lot of smoko's from time to time. Sorry if your stumped about what's been said, but you need to chuck a shrimp on the barbie and chill this arvo and veg out a bit listening to Accadacca.

Overall we are checking out if we can raise a large enough mob interested in giving IBT Island the thumbs up. If we get a big enough tribe we will pop into STEAM and say "Here ya go!, are you still interested or are we going to bail?" Lots of hard yakka did go into this and we really love Straya and if we can get into STEAM we would be totally Rapt. If nobody is interested we will feel a bit like a Wally. 

This game shouldn't be too iffy for ankle biters also.

Catch ya later.

notes.title: So far so good.
notes.notes:
Hello people!

No bugs have been reported since the full release of DASM Spell Quest! 

Though,  before releasing DASM Spell Quest we did go through a lot of painful and time consuming testing and fixed (or patched up), any bugs as we came across them. 

Please, as a reminder contact us if you come across any issues at all. We are more than happy to take a look at anything that has been reported.

Have fun!

notes.title: World of DASM, DASM Spell Quest Release.
notes.notes:
Hi people!
Yes!.... Today is the day we release DASM Spell Quest from Early Access!. 
[h1][b]To celebrate our release we currently are selling the software with 40% off![/b][/h1]
The software has been through a number of tests and only a few bugs have been reported but we have fixed them to the best of our ability. If you do come across any bugs or issues please leave a message here in our forums https://steamcommunity.com/app/543910/discussions/0/1354868867706525555/ or email us at contact@worldofdasm.com

We hope you enjoy our "educational game" and the unusual twists and turns that it contains. There is no other software that uses our methods of teaching anywhere on the market. What makes it so unique is that it uses a combination of modern humor and old fashioned styles of learning. The visual environment of DASM Spell Quest has an old ancient feel to it but also has a combination of modern technology to give the player/user a feeling of familiarity but also mystery.


So sit back, relax...and enter The World of DASM if you dare. But be aware this software can be addictive to adults, so let the children play.

Have a great day!

notes.title: No we are not Abandonware!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

For some reason a Curator has posted that we are Abandonware. We do realize it had been quite some time since our last post but it would have been courteous if they had of Emailed us or contacted us first to see if this was a fact. We would have been more than happy to reply!!

So no, we are not Abandonware and we will attempt to fix any reported bugs or issues if reported. Currently we have not received any Emails or messages on anything that may be buggy or not working correctly. Also, since our release we have not had any complaints. Therefore, everything must be working fine!

We will continue to support our product for as long as possible but as always technology  changes constantly and some newer hardware may no longer or will not support this software in the future without some form of emulator.

Please Email contact@worldofdasm.com or message us here in the community forums if you have any more questions. We will be happy to help!

Have a Great Day!!...

notes.title: DASM Spell Quest leaving Early Access. (6th June)
notes.notes:
Hello people! 

Due to having no major bugs or issues DASM Spell Quest will be leaving early access. It has been 2 years since STEAM was kind enough to release our Software on their platform and we feel its now time to release it, "as is".

We have added the most common Questions and Answers below in this post that we have been asked over the past 12 months. Please feel free to message us here in the community forums or email us at contact@worldofdasm.com if you have any further questions or issues.

[u][b]But what if there are still bugs??[/b][/u]

Don't panic! We will attempt to fix any bugs that have been reported. We will not abandon our product and will do our best for our customers.

[u][b]Will there be any more expansions/changes?[/b][/u]

Depending on the popularity we may add extra features. Though, since UDK is no longer supported by Epic Games, it is likely that there will be no further development. This isn't by our choice but modern operating systems and hardware/drivers are always changing and don't always support older software.

[u][b]I have a good idea, still interested?[/b][/u]

Yes we are! Especially if its to do with Education. We would love to hear any ideas that you may have. There may even be a DASM Spell Quest 2 in the future, who knows!

[u][b]I heard that DASM Spell Quest is Abandonware, is that true?[/b][/u]

No, it is not true. 

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Fix for windows 10 (Save files not saving.)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thanks to one of my good friends Mr Nikolov (Thanks mate!), has made me aware that DASM Spell Quest or even the save system it uses does not work correctly with Windows 10. 

[u]Here is what was in the e-mail:[/u]

[i][b]Windows 10 users by default have on the system Microsoft .NET Framework 4 or 4.5 and up. But for the save system to work, windows 10 users will have to install, Microsoft .NET Framework 3.5 and possibly after that install the Microsoft .NET Framework 3.5 service pack 1 and the save system will work once more!![/b][/i]

Or you can try these links below and follow the instructions:
https://answers.microsoft.com/en-us/insider/forum/insider_wintp-insider_install-insiderplat_pc/how-to-instal-net-framework-35-on-windows-10/450b3ba6-4d19-45ae-840e-78519f36d7a4
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/install/dotnet-35-windows-10
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZHzulOODC2w

If you are having any save game problems still or errors related to saved games make a post in the link provided below so we can try and resolve any issues as they arise.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/543910/discussions/0/1696048879953696000/

Thanks!

The patch is ready to go very soon! Unfortunately when we tried to release the first patch of this type (which was similar), sadly it had a few issues so we had to roll it back to a previous install.

notes.title: Latest Patch and Free Expansion,”DASM Outskirts” is to be released very soon!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/230ba2a56c80cdaccf2e355af917b3b0b7f6199c.jpg[/img]
Hello people how are we? I have some great news for all the DASM fans that emailed us and said that they are half way through the game and have quite a few spelling tokens left in their inventory.  If you are not aware DASM Spell Quest allows you to carry a maximum of 100 spelling tokens so you must spend the tokens as you collect them. (There is a chance this may change in the future.) Unfortunately the current problem is even if you do spend your tokens at the shops you will still have a few tokens left over and this has become an issue.
Therefore DASM Outskirts has been created to fix this problem. Now the good news is this expansion will be free because of the wonderful feedback from parents, guardians and teachers who use our software. Yes that’s right, just from contacting us and providing us feedback we are happy to please!
[b][h1]What does this expansion have to offer?[/h1][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/e93144b811a0a0c23171c81a7c0fc421fa0c10a1.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Own your very own motel room![/u][/b]
Why not buy a motel room and purchase some furniture for it? Go shopping and buy some goods from 3 stores to decorate your own home. Even if you don’t have enough to buy a room the motel owner will still let you decorate it. (But it will still cost you!)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/dfe416425eeef887d37586cac358ca4e0b1148ee.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Caravan Park. (Trailer Park.)[/u][/b]
Want to buy some used caravans? Want a place to own with some great scenery? Buy a caravan!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/df7ff7f7a957ec21c8c9c98e9e2a107cfb583b8c.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Businesses.[/u][/b]
Want to purchase a business? Got enough tokens? Are you a business person? Then become even more of a citizen of DASM by buying various properties.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/0c33355dfcd4c0152a45fe781826c9ef4439f588.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Library.[/u][/b]
Need to return a lost overdue library book? Well you have come to the right place! The library will give out a reward for any lost books returned. You can also buy books and shelving here for your motel room if you wish to do so.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/5336b67af9ac6396f95925ca9e5ac0feaa163311.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Missions.[/u][/b]
There are only a few missions to do in the expansion because it was mainly created so you can spend  spelling tokens and have a little time out from doing all the puzzles. DASM Outskirts does not offer too much for you if you don’t have any tokens to spend.

[b][h1]Final words.[/h1][/b]
We feel it is our duty to try and make our software more playable and fun by listening to comments and feedback that anyone has for us. 
We also want to make it clear to save any confusion that this game is for “children only” who are just starting to learn or are having learning difficulties. So please, especially anyone who has comments for us make sure you understand the fundamental principles of this game before you comment publically.
 If you’re not sure what to say here in STEAM email us at: [b]feedback@worldofdasm.com[/b] and we will gladly listen to what you have to say. (Most people do!)

Please don’t forget to report any bugs!
Report any bugs here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/543910/discussions/0/1354868867706525555/
Thank you.

notes.title: Latest patch is now out!
notes.notes:
Hello people!  We have released a second patch to tidy up a few things that were overlooked during testing. Special thanks to everyone that emailed us directly via our website and reported some issues.
[list]

Please email us or place a message here if you’re having any problems: http://steamcommunity.com/app/543910/discussions/0/1354868867706525555/

notes.title: World of DASM, DASM Spell Quest is here!
notes.notes:
Hello people!

DASM Spell Quest is now ready for release and we are all excited here at DASM HQ. All the fans and educators who have been following us from the start know that this software has evolved over time and has been shaped by the general community, students and yes the teachers!

This software was specifically created and designed for students aged between 5 to 12 years old who are struggling to learn the alphabet or spelling words. DASM Spell Quest also helps to form the very basic building blocks for sentence structure, and contains a substantial amount of reading material with full audio and text. 

Unlike most ABC type software programs DASM Spell Quest is well…a little twisted! It uses a whole new style of teaching and learning techniques to keep users interested.

Since this will be an Alpha release we kindly ask the STEAM community to report any bugs or issues if they arise.

notes.title: World of DASM, DASM Spell Quest is here!
notes.notes:
Hello people!

DASM Spell Quest is now ready for release and we are all excited here at DASM HQ. All the fans and educators who have been following us from the start know that this software has evolved over time and has been shaped by the general community, students and yes the teachers!

This software was specifically created and designed for students aged between 5 to 12 years old who are struggling to learn the alphabet or spelling words. DASM Spell Quest also helps to form the very basic building blocks for sentence structure, and contains a substantial amount of reading material with full audio and text. 

Unlike most ABC type software programs DASM Spell Quest is well…a little twisted! It uses a whole new style of teaching and learning techniques to keep users interested.

Since this will be an Alpha release we kindly ask the STEAM community to report any bugs or issues if they arise. 

Any adults who wish to use this software be warned that it is for your child or student.  Once trapped in the World of DASM time can slip away and you yourself can become its next victim. 

Welcome to the World of DASM!
